Board Game Library Night

Monday 28 September 2026, 6:00pm

Fixture Hall, 1 Example Street, West End QLD 4101

Three hundred games on the shelves and staff who will teach any of them. Tables for two to eight. Kitchen open until 9pm. Booking is not required but the room fills on wet nights.

Free. Doors open thirty minutes before the listed time. The hall is wheelchair accessible from the Example Street entrance.
